description: This file implements the DataElementFile class, which manages memory-mapped file operations including opening, closing, reallocation, and synchronization across different platforms (Windows, POSIX). It handles file creation, opening, resizing, and memory mapping, providing an abstraction for file-backed memory buffers.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: A class that manages file-backed memory buffers with platform-specific memory mapping, supporting operations like open, close, reallocate, and sync.
